INTRO DATS
SEPT 23, WH

Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H in the area
bound by:

West Marquette Road; the public alley next east of and parallel to South Western
Avenue: a line 347.18 feet next south of and parallel to West Marquette Road; and
South Western Avenue

to those of C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6701-31 S. Western Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
